'''William Bain''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Strange High House]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Luck]]
*+1 [[Speed]]

Remove 1 [[doom token]] from the [[doom track]] when William Bain joins you.
